title: Permissive CORS wildcard origin — review required
description: An allow_origins list contains the "*" wildcard, so any website can read cross-origin responses, including responses tied to ambient credentials. This lexical rule flags the wildcard entry; the reviewer confirms whether any credentialed endpoint serves it.
remediation: Replace "*" with an explicit allowlist of trusted origins. Never combine a wildcard with allow_credentials, and keep preflight cache lifetimes short.
limitation: Lexical, single-line: a wildcard built by concatenation or spread across lines is missed. Regex- or function-based origin checks are out of scope.
